title: Deploy backend and dashboard publicly
context: A live public URL is stronger evidence than a 'clone and run locally' README, matching your existing TaskDrift deployment patterns (Cloud Run for backend, Vercel for frontend).
objective: Deploy both services and confirm they're reachable from outside your network.
scope_in: Env vars/secrets configured on both platforms, not committed to the repo
acceptance_criteria: Backend health endpoint reachable via public Cloud Run URL from a different network
Dashboard reachable via public Vercel URL and successfully loads real session data from the deployed backend
No secrets present anywhere in the deployed build logs or client-side bundle
